codex-execution.title: Codex model & usage notices
codex-execution.intro: Choose a model and reasoning effort from the current worker’s CLI catalog. The preview fixes this configuration.
codex-execution.notice_hint: Leave blank for no attempt notice. Crossing this threshold sends a notice; it does not guarantee a stop or spending limit.
codex-execution.boundary: This integration confirms CLI settings and observes usage. It does not attest the provider’s actual model or guarantee a hard allowance or exact cost.
codex-execution.invalid_options: Model options do not match the current project or tool. Refresh them.
codex-execution.notice_exceeded: Observed usage exceeded the attempt notice threshold. Follow the actual execution state.
codex-execution.invalid_response: The response does not match the original task or Codex configuration. The original operation was kept for recovery.
